        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_WhenOperationCanceled_LogsTimeoutError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>(); // Assuming interface or make_virtual needed
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object>()))
                .Returns(Task.FromCanceled(new OperationCanceledException()));
            
            var session = new TestableMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object)
            {
                migrateOperation = new[] { new MockMigrateOperation { Client = mockClient.Object } },
                _timeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100),
                _cts = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource(),
                _sslots = new[] { 1, 2, 3 },
                _slotRanges = new object() // Simplified
            };

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node123", MigrateState.IMPORT);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            Assert.Equal(MigrateState.FAIL, session.Status);
            
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t.Contains("SetSlotRange operation timed out or was cancelled after 100ms for slots")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_WhenUnexpectedException_LogsExceptionError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<IClusterClient>();
            var expectedEx = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object>()))
                .ThrowsAsync(expectedEx);
            
            var session = new TestableMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object)
            {
                migrateOperation = new[] { new MockMigrateOperation { Client = mockClient.Object } },
                _timeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100),
                _cts = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource(),
                _sslots = new[] { 1, 2, 3 },
                _slotRanges = new object()
            };

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node123", MigrateState.IMPORT);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            Assert.Equal(MigrateState.FAIL, session.Status);
            
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t.Contains("An error occurred during SetSlotRange for slots")),
                    expectedEx,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TryRecoverFromFailureAsync_WhenTrySetSlotRangesAsyncFails_LogsRecoveryError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var session = new TestableMigrateSession(_mockLogger.Object)
            {
                TrySetSlotRangesAsyncResult = false
            };

            // Act
            var result = await session.TryRecoverFromFailureAsync();

            // Assert

        public override async Task<bool> TrySetSlotRangesAsync(string nodeid, MigrateState state)

            if (!TrySetSlotRangesAsyncResult) return false;
            return base.TrySetSlotRangesAsync(nodeid, state).Result; // Simplified
        }
